camel_example: aliyun cs GET /addons/coredns --region cn-hangzhou --cluster_version '1.26.3-aliyun.1' --cluster_id c02b3e03be10643e8a644a843ffcb0000 --cluster_spec 'ack.pro.small' --profile Default --region_id 'cn-hangzhou' --cluster_type ManagedKubernetes --version 'v1.9.3.10-7dfca203-aliyun' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Invokes the DescribeAddon operation to perform a parameter query for information about a specified component based on parameters such as region, cluster type, cluster child class (profile), cluster version, and component name. The returned information includes whether the component is managed, the component categorization, the schema of supported custom parameters, compatible operating system architectures, and the minimum cluster version required by the component version
description_zh: 您可以调用DescribeAddon接口，根据指定地域、集群类型、集群子类型（profile）、集群版本、组件名称等参数查询目标组件的信息，包括组件托管与否、组件分类、支持的自定义参数Schema、兼容的操作系统架构、该版本要求的最低集群版本等
kebab_example: aliyun cs describe-addon --addon-name coredns --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-type ManagedKubernetes --biz-profile Default --cluster-spec ack.pro.small --cluster-version 1.26.3-aliyun.1 --cluster-id c02b3e03be10643e8a644a843ffcb0000 --biz-version v1.9.3.10-7dfca203-aliyun --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAddon
